headline_finding.explanation: StarParticleInitialize + StarParticleFinalize run once per subcycle of EVERY level (4327 subcycles in this 5-root-step run; L10 alone 2140). They were the whole of the previously unattributed 62.8%.
headline_finding.interpretation_pending: Not yet known whether this is work or synchronization wait. StarParticleFinalize calls CommunicationUpdateStarParticleCount = MPI_Allreduce over 2*NumberOfGrids ints, which is also a barrier and therefore absorbs upstream load imbalance. Payload cost of that Allreduce on 128 ranks is ~1 ms against 337 ms measured, so <1% is communication payload. Pass 4 (sha f62e1945) splits SPInitialize/SPFinalize and times the Allreduce and the hierarchy walk directly.
headline_finding.if_imbalance: Would make T2.1 (particle-aware load-balance work estimate) the highest-value remaining audit item, and would explain the null result of T0.2 (Hilbert balancing on cells-only weights).
